Aisha (CSM): Morning team — Stonebridge cutover is 14:00 UTC today. Quick pre-cut check: egress to Splunk (HTTPS 443 + optional 10514 for syslog), KMS key access, IAM role for the inference service, and audit log shipping to customer S3. Any last-minute blockers?
Diego (NetEng): Firewall rules pushed to staging. Plan to push to prod at T-30 if no objections. Note: Splunk expects TLS on 443; we proxy via NAT GW. Do we have the final allowlist from the customer for the static IPs?
Aisha (CSM): They promised the allowlist this morning — I’ll paste it here when I get it. Sam, did we already provide the three static egress IPs?
Sam (Security): Confirmed — IPs sent in onboarding doc. Re: KMS, customer asked for dual-admin oversight and explicit service principal for decrypt. Liam, can you confirm what’s in the key policy?
Liam (Infra): Created key alias alias/rw-stonebridge-llm and enabled automatic rotation. Current key policy grants the customer admin ARN and Redwood admin role. I did not add the Redwood service principal for decrypt yet — we can add a separate statement for that.
Sam (Security): Please add it. I’ll push a small policy diff. Also want to run a pre-cut checklist: ensure aws:SourceVpce condition is in the bucket policy for audit logs.
Diego (NetEng): About audit logs — we will use a VPC endpoint to S3. Customer bucket policy requires vpce condition. Liam, do we have the endpoint ID we can reference?
Liam (Infra): Created vpce-0a1b2c3d in their account for com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3. I updated the bucket policy to allow that vpce. I’ll paste the snippet to docs after cutover.
Aisha (CSM): Any expected downtime or user-visible blips?
Liam (Infra): No user-visible downtime. We'll do a rolling restart of runtime agents — a few seconds of connection re-negotiation for in-flight sessions possible but no SLA impact.
Sam (Security): Can we run a replay of audit logs for the last 24h post-cut to confirm there are no gaps? If yes, Diego can trigger.
Diego (NetEng): Yep — I can trigger a replay. Plan: run at T+15 and verify counts against Splunk ingestion.
Aisha (CSM): Good. Small reminder: customer requested KMS key usage audit and a note in the handoff doc about rotation cadence.
Sam (Security): I'll add the rotation cadence and the audit instructions to the handoff doc.
deploy-bot: Scheduled cutover for stonebridge private deploy at 2026-03-21T14:00:00Z by @Aisha (CSM) :white_check_mark:
Aisha (CSM): Action items recap: 1) Diego — push prod fw at T-30 and run replay at T+15; 2) Liam — confirm vpce ID in docs and paste final bucket policy; 3) Sam — add Redwood service principal to KMS policy and update rotation/audit in handoff doc. I’ll do a 14:20 quick check-in here. :thumbsup:
Liam (Infra): Noted, will confirm vpce/bucket policy within 10.
Sam (Security): Policy diff incoming — posting link in thread when ready.
Diego (NetEng): Pushing now, will update once prod change is live.
Aisha (CSM): Thanks team — ping in this thread if anything blocks. I’ll post the customer's final allowlist when I get it.
